notes.title: Love Colors 1.0.1 Hotfix - Further achievement fix
notes.notes:

 Fixed the achievement not unlocking properly after finishing an associated collection
Chapter Two

 Fixed the achievement not unlocking properly after finishing an associated collection

notes.title: Love Colors patch 1.0.1 - Achievements fix
notes.notes:
Hello Pixel lovers,

We've checked your feedback regarding some achievements that haven't been unlocking properly. They should now work as smoothly as your brush!

Grab the list of changes here:

Precise Painter

 Changing colors doesn't break the counter for this achievement to unlock
Tool Master

 Fixed the pixel counter
Achievements related to finishing a collection

 All achievements unlocked by finishing a collection should now work properly


And if you haven't grabbed your copy of Love Colors, check out the 40% launch discount, while it lasts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561060/Love_Colors_Paint_with_Friends/
